subject.title: fix(agents): include requester identity in sessions_send context (Fixes #38570)

question: After reviewing redacted live A2A evidence, should OpenClaw accept configured requester identity text in the agent-to-agent system-prompt boundary?
rationale: The patch uses the existing line sanitizer and has focused regressions, but whether this configuration-derived prompt context is acceptable remains an explicitly protected human-review decision.

options.title: Require live A2A proof, then review

options.title: Decline this prompt context
